No son pocos los análisis cinematográficos de la obra que la han tildado de «izquierdista», de poseer una sensibilidad especial hacia causas «progresistas»" Every quoted phrase must be followed by an unquoted explanation.assistant

The second part of "Dune", the adaptation of Denis Villeneuve's novel of the same name by Frank Herbert, premiered yesterday. There are many film analyses of the work that have labeled it as "leftist", possessing a special sensitivity towards "progressive" causes.

In this context, "izquierdista" refers to a political or ideological alignment that is often associated with left-wing or progressive views. This term is used to describe a film that is seen as promoting or reflecting liberal or socialist values.

The phrase "poseer una sensibilidad especial hacia causas 'progresistas'" means that the film has a particular sensitivity or empathy towards progressive causes. This implies that the film is seen as being sympathetic to or supportive of social or political movements that are considered progressive or forward-thinking.
